pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches exhibit complex polygonal and stellate geometries with irregular, high-frequency edge serrations. Flank patches are significantly larger in spatial area than the smaller, more fragmented patches observed on the lower neck and limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous light-colored lattice forms a topological graph with predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. The corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, exhibiting localized narrowing at junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette consisting of dense, vertical fiber-like pixel clusters against the background.
